summary: Optional defaults for the Timelapse widget. The widget works without this section.

fields.label: Default kind
fields.tip: What a timepoint is when the widget opens: camera frames, a scan, or a tiling. Kinds the setup cannot run are not offered.

fields.label: Default timepoints
fields.tip: Initial value of the widget only; every run uses what the operator entered.

fields.label: Default interval (s)
fields.tip: Initial value of the widget only; every run uses what the operator entered.

fields.label: Default interval measured
fields.tip: start_to_start = fixed cadence; end_to_start = delay after each timepoint ends.

fields.label: Default frames per timepoint
fields.tip: Camera timelapses only. Initial value of the widget only.

fields.label: Default one file for all
fields.tip: Camera and scan timelapses: one grouped HDF5/Zarr file for all timepoints instead of one file each.

fields.label: Illumination settle (ms)
fields.tip: Extra wait after switching the lasers on, for sources slower than one camera frame (shutters, AOTF rise). Leave blank when none is declared; the data then says so.
